newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-NORMAN BOOSTS HIS BUSINESS EMPIRE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NORMAN BOOSTS HIS BUSINESS EMPIRE.

text.p: Greg Norman took a further step into big business by joining forces with an Australian investment bank to build golf resorts worldwide, the bank said on Monday.
The Australian golfer and current world number two has entered a joint venture with Macquarie Bank to raise investment funds to back the project, according to a bank statement.
The company, Turnberry Resort Developments, is considering eight sites in Australia for projects worth more than A$500 million (US$365 million), the bank said in a statement.
In addition to designing and building golf courses, the joint venture will also involve property and leisure development.
Quoted in the bank statement, Norman said the new company represented a logical extension to his existing business empire, which focuses on leisure wear and golf course design.
The double British Open winner's business income already dwarfs his earnings from tournament prize money.
